title: The memorandum promise — DeMentas v. Tallas
shortTitle: The memorandum promise — DeMentas v. Tallas
summary: A written and notarized memorandum promises $50,000 in recognition of assistance already rendered.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Does the writing, its formality, the past assistance, or any additional undertaking supply enforceability? Distinguish evidence of a promise from a substantive substitute for consideration. Apply the relevant jurisdiction rather than treating notarization as universally conclusive.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
